entities.name: Mar del Plata Museum of the Sea
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Museum of the Sea was a museum of marine biology and aquarium in the seaside city of Mar del Plata, Argentina. The museum closed its doors in September 2012, after 12 years in operation.
